I develop and apply molecular and genomic tools to address marine
conservation and fisheries-management challenges, particularly in
species for which the biological information needed for effective
management remains limited.

My research spans population genetics, molecular identification, and
biodiversity monitoring in marine invertebrates. At Dalhousie University,
I am extending this work into population genomics and movement ecology,
integrating low-coverage whole-genome sequencing with acoustic telemetry
in Atlantic cod.
